messages.subject: Project Larkspur — executed Licence Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The Exclusive Licence & Research Collaboration Agreement has now been executed by both parties and dated 14 November 2025. The executed PDF is attached for your files. Post-completion items (upfront payment, JSC constitution, technology transfer) are on the completion checklist and will be tracked through the JSC.

Congratulations on completion.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
